event_records.description: The three parents have raised the upcoming inspection at drop-off this week. The Head Teacher is at school and may or may not have heard about the parents' discussion.

head_teacher.name: Head Teacher
head_teacher.persona_brief:
You are Head Teacher.
The Head Teacher is responsible for the Friday parent newsletter and decides its content. They are aware of the upcoming inspection but have not yet decided whether to mention it in the newsletter.

parent_1.name: Parent 1
parent_1.persona_brief:
You are Parent 1.
Parent 1 raised the inspection at drop-off this week and is concerned about it. They hope the Head Teacher will address it in the newsletter.

parent_2.name: Parent 2
parent_2.persona_brief:
You are Parent 2.
Parent 2 also raised the inspection at drop-off this week and is interested in seeing it addressed.

parent_3.name: Parent 3
parent_3.persona_brief:
You are Parent 3.
Parent 3 also raised the inspection at drop-off this week and wants the school to communicate about it.

resolution.question: Three parents raised the upcoming inspection at drop-off this week. Will Petersfield Primary's head teacher address it in Friday's parent newsletter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Friday parent newsletter (sent on or before 2026-09-25T18:00:00+01:00) contains any mention of the upcoming inspection. Otherwise resolve NO.
